analysis_definition.claim_boundary: This is orientation-resolved local-state pairing, not by itself a continuous chirality-magnitude assignment or a claim of macroscopic framework chirality.
analysis_definition.discovery_stage: Pairing is discovered from CR-PLS/2 records generated from the supplied P1 CIFs; the separately supplied Sohncke flag is joined only afterward.
analysis_definition.paired_entry: A state-bearing MOF entry in which at least one canonical metric ID occurs with more than one canonical stereo ID within that same entry.
